renderer_effects_policy: Cached method-level reachability selects original renderers that call World block mutators. Original callbacks run once per hosted server tick with discarded graphics. Client renderer writes are suppressed; shared renderer instances are locked between simulation and drawing.
generic_guard: PASS: 261 Beta production/loader source files; no listed mod-identity selectors outside tests

additional_default_unit_gate.covers: Transitive reachable mutation, unreachable method exclusion, inherited virtual dispatch and pure visual renderer exclusion

limitations: Headless callback, native collision and packet/factory tests do not establish live client rendering or a manual relog result.
Ogre persistence is proved by authoritative chunk state and independent serialized palette decoding in disposable worlds; no user world was modified.
Renderer effect discovery does not infer reflective calls or arbitrary helper-interface polymorphism; effects run per server tick rather than viewer frames.
Native collision and owner-collision grace policies remain; the complete original Beta arrow collision engine is not reproduced.
Original army allied-attack fall-through, autonomous targeting without a master controller, and lifetime NBT omission are preserved rather than corrected.
Vanilla and modern entities retain native rules. Existing modern fauna competition for Beta caps and fixed Beta height sampling remain.
